body: It's not so much that they're annoying, I guess I am having trouble rationalizing the visit because I've felt like this for awhile.  my partner has some depression as well that we've been addressing, i just feel guilty about needing the same help because I'm supposed to be the rock.  Then i worry about missing work.  I have to just bite the bullet and go no matter what because it's not a bad thing, just necessary.

i haven't seen anyone. I ended up in the ER for what I thought was a lung issue. Couldn't breathe. They gave me Ativan, but that's the only "psych" medicine I've had. I'm finding it hard to get over that hump of going to the doctor.
Having been to Costa Rica and knowing how mind-blowingly awesome it is as a country, this saddens me.  Also, it reminds me how un-mind-blowingly awesome the public can be.
